title: Rest for a Sore Knee
story: During football practice, Amina felt a sharp pain in her left knee. She stopped running and told the coach at once. The coach moved her to a bench and brought a cold pack. Amina held the pack on her knee and kept her leg straight. She did not finish the match. Her teammate Jules brought her water and sat with her. After practice, the coach wrote a note for Amina's parents. The note said to rest and to use the cold pack at home. It also said to skip training for a week. Amina felt disappointed, but she followed the plan. She watched the next session from the side and cheered. Each evening she stretched gently, as the coach had shown her. By Friday the pain was mild, and she could walk without a limp. She asked to return, but the coach said one more rest day was wise.
